chart.description: Evolution of the number of running containers
chart.name: Containers
CPU %
chart.programText:
A = data('cpu.usage.system', filter=(not filter('cloud.platform', 'aws_ecs')), rollup='rate').publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('cpu.usage.total', filter=(not filter('cloud.platform', 'aws_ecs')), rollup='rate').publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = (100*B/A).publish(label='C', enable=False)
D = (C).min().publish(label='D')
E = (C).percentile(pct=10).publish(label='E')
F = (C).percentile(pct=50).publish(label='F')
G = (C).percentile(pct=90).publish(label='G')
H = (C).max().publish(label='H')

publishLabelOptions.displayName: A/B*100 - Mean(15s) - Sum by plugin_instance - Top 10
publishLabelOptions.label: C

chart.programText:
A = data('cpu.usage.total', filter=filter('plugin', 'docker') and (not filter('cloud.platform', 'aws_ecs')), rollup='rate').publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('cpu.usage.system', filter=filter('plugin', 'docker') and (not filter('cloud.platform', 'aws_ecs')), rollup='rate').publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = (A/B*100).mean(over='15s').sum(by=['plugin_instance']).top(count=10).publish(label='C')
